Class Street

java.lang.Object
traffic.model.Street
public class Street extends Object
The full street: a collection of lanes plus a row of parking spots down one side. Holds the currently-active accident (if any).

    • allVehicles

      public Stream<Vehicle> allVehicles()
      Every vehicle on the street, across all lanes, as one stream. Because the stream element type is the base class Vehicle, callers handle Car / EmergencyVehicle / PoliceVehicle uniformly (subtype polymorphism), which lets the read-only counting/iteration code stay a single line.

      Use only for READ-ONLY passes — do not add/remove vehicles while streaming (that would mutate the lanes mid-iteration).
